description: This file defines the Returns model class for the OpenCart system, handling operations related to product return records such as adding returns, retrieving return details, histories, and counts within the customer account module.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: A model class for handling product return data, including adding new returns, fetching details, histories, and counts related to return records.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Creates a new return record in the database with the provided data, returning the ID of the inserted record.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific return record by its return ID, including associated reason, action, and status names.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Fetches a list of return records for the current customer with pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total number of return records associated with the current customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Fetches the list of history entries for a given return, such as status changes and comments.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history entries for a specific return record.
